name: Print Monitor
description: 3D print status for a Bambu Lab printer (via Home Assistant) in the NBA / NFL / NHL Live arcade style: the model's thumbnail, a big percent, time left and ETA, nozzle and bed temperatures, layer count and a segmented gauge in the filament colour. Preparing, paused and failed prints get their own screens, and a finished print bursts onto the panel. Idle printers are skipped so the rotation moves on.
author: ant456

versions.notes: First release: printing, preparing, paused, failed and done screens, PRINT DONE! burst, model thumbnail from the printer's cover image, filament-colour gauge, on-demand interrupt for done / failed / paused, idle skip.
